# GoldCord

> GoldCord is a free, open-source volunteer hours tracker for Western Michigan University Lee Honors College students. It is an independent student project and is not affiliated with WMU or the Lee Honors College.

Students log service sessions, track progress toward the yearly 20 hour requirement (10 in some cases), review the year in a scrapbook, and copy every field of the LHC Community Service Log in form order. Accounts require a verified @wmich.edu email, and each student's records are private to their account.

## Pages

- [Home](https://goldcord-app.vercel.app/): what GoldCord does, an interactive demo, and FAQs
- [Privacy](https://goldcord-app.vercel.app/privacy): what is stored, who processes it, and how to delete it
- [Terms](https://goldcord-app.vercel.app/terms): terms of use
- [Security](https://goldcord-app.vercel.app/security): how accounts and data are protected
